summary: Complete reels admin system implemented successfully with backend API, frontend interface, and navigation integration. However, duplicate navigation entries and route mounting create user confusion and potential routing conflicts. URL validation security gap allows malicious domains, and missing null checks for deleted product references could cause display issues.
findings: Duplicate navigation entries - Three identical 'Reels' navigation items appear in admin sidebar causing UI confusion
Duplicate route mounting - Backend app.js mounts /api/admin/reels route twice potentially causing routing conflicts
URL validation security gap - Substring matching allows malicious domains like cloudinary.com.evil.com to pass validation
Missing null handling for deleted product references - Frontend will break when displaying reels with invalid product IDs
